title: Tanshinone IIA Ameliorates Heart Failure by Inhibiting Ferroptosis via the Sirt1/p53/GPX4 Signaling Pathway.
authors: Zhong, Guo-Fu; Jiang, Zhi-Wen; Huang, Xin; Lin, Bo; Zhu, Qing-Hua; Wang, Ling; Xu, Mujuan; Liu, Yuxiang; Wang, Maosheng; Han, Yue
journal: The American journal of Chinese medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹参酮IIA通过Sirt1/p53/GPX4通路抑制心肌细胞铁死亡改善心衰，属于心血管疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Heart failure (HF) is a high-mortality condition driven by cardiomyocyte death, and ferroptosis is a critical contributor to myocardial injury in this regard. Tanshinone IIA (Tan-IIA), a bioactive component from Salvia miltiorrhiza, has been shown to protect the heart, but its role in HF-related ferroptosis remains unclear. This study investigated whether Tan-IIA ameliorates HF by inhibiting ferroptosis and its underlying mechanism. We evaluated cardiac function, fibrosis, ferroptosis markers (such as ROS, Fe[Formula: see text], GSH, xCT, and GPX4), and Sirt1/p53 signaling using both a mouse model of HF induced by ligation of the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery and oxygen-glucose deprivation (OGD)-treated H9c2 cells. Direct binding of Tan-IIA to Sirt1 was verified by molecular docking, CETSA, and DARTS. Tan-IIA improved cardiac function, reduced fibrosis and inflammation, decreased ROS/Fe[Formula: see text], increased GSH, and upregulated xCT/GPX4 in vivo and in vitro. However, erastin reversed these effects. Tan-IIA upregulated Sirt1 and downregulated p53, while Sirt1 inhibition by EX527 abolished its cardioprotective and antiferroptotic actions. Tan-IIA ameliorates HF by inhibiting myocardial ferroptosis through the Sirt1/p53/GPX4 pathway thus in turn supports its potential clinical use in the treatment of HF.
abstract_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）是一种由心肌细胞死亡驱动的高死亡率疾病，而铁死亡（ferroptosis）在此背景下是心肌损伤的关键促成因素。丹参酮IIA（Tan-IIA）是丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza）中的一种生物活性成分，已被证明具有心脏保护作用，但其在HF相关铁死亡中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了Tan-IIA是否通过抑制铁死亡改善HF及其潜在机制。我们使用左前降支（LAD）冠状动脉结扎诱导的HF小鼠模型和氧-葡萄糖剥夺（OGD）处理的H9c2细胞，评估了心脏功能、纤维化、铁死亡标志物（如ROS、Fe[公式：见原文]、GSH、xCT和GPX4）以及Sirt1/p53信号通路。通过分子对接（molecular docking）、CETSA和DARTS验证了Tan-IIA与Sirt1的直接结合。Tan-IIA在体内和体外均改善了心脏功能，减少了纤维化和炎症，降低了ROS/Fe[公式：见原文]，增加了GSH，并上调了xCT/GPX4。然而，erastin逆转了这些效应。Tan-IIA上调Sirt1并下调p53，而EX527对Sirt1的抑制则消除了其心脏保护和抗铁死亡作用。Tan-IIA通过Sirt1/p53/GPX4通路抑制心肌铁死亡从而改善HF，这进而支持其在HF治疗中的潜在临床应用。
